shop.open_status: DB has no open_status column; should be dynamically determined from open_hours
shop.phone: DB tb_shop has no phone column
shop.tags: DB tb_shop has no tags column; could be introduced as a separate table
shop.alias: DB tb_shop has no alias column
shop.aliases: DB tb_shop has no aliases column
shop.sub_category: DB uses type_id foreign key; sub_category is too granular

voucher.stock: stock is only stored in tb_seckill_voucher for type=1 (seckill) vouchers; all mock vouchers are type=0 (普通券)

distance_eta.distance_km: DB has no distance_eta table; distance should be dynamically calculated from shop coordinates (tb_shop.x, tb_shop.y) and user location
distance_eta.eta_minutes: same as above; ETA can be estimated from distance
distance_eta.traffic_level: same as above; not stored in DB
distance_eta._note: distance_eta.json is NOT imported in any phase of this seed process

open_status_handling: skipped — DB has no open_status column; can be derived from open_hours + current time
